environment.description: Same application deployed on the same EC2/ALB stack, but with three additional infrastructure controls: (1) AWS WAF WebACL associated with the ALB containing AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule in COUNT mode and a custom rule that blocks requests where any JSON value field exceeds 64 characters (using byte match on body with text transformation NONE and regex pattern matching values longer than 64 chars between quotes); (2) The EC2 instance runs with a mandatory AppArmor profile ('report-service') that confines /usr/local/bin/report-gen to only execute with arguments matching the pattern '--type (summary|detailed|audit|compliance) --range [a-z0-9_]+ --template [a-z0-9_]+ --output /var/data/reports/[a-z_]+_[0-9]+\.(pdf|csv|xlsx)' and denies all exec transitions from the report-gen binary; (3) The subprocess invocation inherits a restricted PATH=/usr/local/bin only, and /usr/local/bin contains only report-gen (no sh, bash, cat, curl, etc.).

config.waf_webacl: Custom rule: BlockLongJsonValues - inspects request body JSON values, blocks if any single value exceeds 64 bytes. Priority 1. Action: BLOCK. AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 2 with SizeRestrictions_BODY in COUNT only.
config.apparmor_profile: profile report-service { /usr/local/bin/report-gen ix, deny /bin/** x, deny /usr/bin/** x, deny /tmp/** x, /var/data/reports/** rw, deny network, deny capability, }
config.path_restriction: Container entrypoint sets PATH=/usr/local/bin; /usr/local/bin contains only: report-gen, gunicorn, python3.9
config.shell_availability: /bin/sh and /bin/bash exist on filesystem but AppArmor denies exec from report-service confined processes
